label: v4 claim frontend adapter
summary: Framework-neutral owner, operator, exact per-id allowance, mint-authority, uint160 currency-id and user-confirmed action checks for explicit ERC-6909 claim actions.
maturityMeaning: Deterministic reusable source is packaged and hash-bound; project integration, tests and review are still required.
requiredFacts: Bind owner, global operator, mint authority, uint160 currency id, amount, action and confirmed read block
Require the executable action kind, owner, currency id and amount to equal the complete user-confirmed action
Bind every allowance to the exact spender, currency id and confirmed remaining amount; never treat it as an ERC-20 or all-id allowance
Present claims separately from ERC-20 balances and PositionManager positions
Reconcile pending mint or burn actions against confirmed PoolManager state
hardConflictPredicates: A burn caller is neither the owner, a confirmed global operator nor the spender of a sufficient allowance for the exact currency id
A per-id allowance for one currency id or spender authorizes a different currency id, spender or mint action
A mint action can be prepared by a caller other than the explicitly bound mint authority
Execution can change the action kind, owner, uint160 currency id or amount after user confirmation
A burn amount can exceed the confirmed claim balance
A claim action can silently substitute a different owner, currency id or amount
